decisions.decision: llama-server installed via Homebrew rather than built from source
inputs: user is on macOS Apple Silicon
llama.cpp bottle exists and is current

alternatives_considered.option: build llama.cpp from source with Metal
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: bottle already has Metal support; build adds 10+ minutes for no gain

alternatives_considered.option: use LM Studio or Ollama as the server
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: spec explicitly requires llama-server from llama.cpp

decisions.weighting_logic: Installation speed > source-of-truth control when the packaged binary is functionally identical
decisions.downstream_impact: none — binary is ABI-equivalent to a from-source build

decisions.decision: llama-server launch params: -ngl 99 (full Metal offload), -c 8192 (context), --jinja (use embedded chat template)
inputs: Gemma 4 26B MoE Q4_K_M is 15.6 GiB — fits in unified memory on Apple Silicon

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: users likely want longer sessions once paradigms pile up in the system prompt
full offload is fastest on M-series with enough RAM

decisions.weighting_logic: Defaults should be 'right for the target hardware' not 'safe for anything'

decisions.decision: llama_server.sh lives at repo root (prod), runtime state in .llama-server/ (gitignored)
inputs: user wants root to be shippable
pid/log files are runtime cruft, not deliverable

alternatives_considered.option: move script to dev/ since MODEL path is user-specific
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: parameterizing via env var in Phase 6 will make it portable enough to ship

alternatives_considered.option: delete the script and only document in README
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: toggle convenience is worth the ~80 lines; users can ignore it

decisions.weighting_logic: Ship the convenience if it can be made portable; mark portability as a todo for Phase 6
decisions.downstream_impact: Phase 6 must add MODEL env-var parameterization

decisions.decision: Package layout: enough/ (package) at repo root, not src/enough/

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: spec overrides; src layout's import-isolation benefit is low for a v0.01 app that isn't a library

decisions.weighting_logic: Follow spec unless there's a concrete reason not to
decisions.reversibility: moderate (would require moving files, updating imports)

decisions.decision: Build system: hatchling via uv, not setuptools
inputs: uv is the env tool chosen
hatchling is uv init's default and is lighter than setuptools for pure-python packages

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: legacy config surface (MANIFEST.in, setup.cfg) adds friction
mixing poetry conventions with uv is confusing

decisions.weighting_logic: Match the tool ecosystem in use

decisions.decision: Tool-call parsing: regex-based on <tool name="X">...</tool> tags
inputs: spec says to use regex/string matching
model output XML won't always be well-formed

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: will fail on unclosed tags mid-stream; spec forbids

decisions.decision: Tool loop cap: 10 iterations per conversation turn
Conversation history lives in server memory (per-process) and resets on restart
inputs: spec says no persistent conversation across restarts
session logs exist for the record

alternatives_considered.option: SQLite or JSON file for durable history
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: out of scope for v0.01; user said no deps beyond fastapi/uvicorn/httpx/sse-starlette

decisions.decision: Session prompt assembly reads .rness/ files fresh on every request (no cache)
inputs: spec explicitly requires: edits to AGENT.md etc. take effect on next message

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: complexity without observable win for v0.01

decisions.weighting_logic: Follow spec; the real cost is a few small disk reads
